name: inside_bar_breakout_v177
mechanism: On NIFTY, sharp 5-second directional bars (>=5 index points range) represent algorithmic momentum bursts where a single institutional order temporarily dominates. The subsequent inside bar forms as market makers reprice and resting limit orders absorb the thrust — a micro-equilibrium where neither bulls nor bears commit. When the next 5-second bar closes beyond the inside bar's boundary in the direction of the mother bar, trapped opposing-side stop-losses trigger and the momentum algos re-enter, driving a 10-20 spot point continuation. The 5s resolution lets us enter at the exact moment directional consensus re-establishes, 30-90 seconds before the move completes.
core_signal_oneliner: Inside bar breakout in direction of large-range mother bar with 3-minute trend alignment
